briefdescription.para: Return the address accessed by this recipe.
Return the mask used by this recipe.

briefdescription.para: Return the VPValues stored by this interleave group.

Return the cost of this VPInterleaveRecipe.
Returns the number of stored operands of this interleave group.
The recipe only uses the first lane of the address.
VPInterleaveRecipe is a recipe for transforming an interleave group of load or stores into one wide load/store and shuffles.

detaileddescription.para: The first operand of a VPInterleave recipe is the address, followed by the stored values, followed by an optional mask.
